title: Google News metadata results
description: Normalized Google News metadata records produced by later Actor stages.

query.title: Query
query.description: The normalized query that produced this result.

sourceName.title: Source name
sourceName.description: The publisher/source name reported by Google News.

googleNewsUrl.title: Google News URL
googleNewsUrl.description: The Google News result URL, not a canonical publisher URL.

publishedAt.title: Published at
publishedAt.description: The source publication timestamp as provided by Google News.

position.title: Position
position.description: The result position within the query result set.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language/locale used for the query.

country.title: Country
country.description: The country/edition used for the query.

scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
scrapedAt.description: The timestamp when the metadata was collected.

sourceUrl.title: Source URL
sourceUrl.description: Optional source URL when available from the metadata feed.

guid.title: GUID
guid.description: Optional source feed identifier when available.
